class.name: OcgTransferDispatchcontrol
class.brief_description: This is an auxiliary class for TransferDispatch, which allows to record simple copies, as CopyControl from Interface, but based on a TransientProcess. Hence, it allows in addition more actions (such as recording results of adaptations)
class.description: ! This is an auxiliary class for TransferDispatch, which allows ! to record simple copies, as CopyControl from Interface, but ! based on a TransientProcess. Hence, it allows in addition ! more actions (such as recording results of adaptations)

method.name: Transfer_DispatchControl
method.description: Creates the DispatchControl, ready for use

method.name: TransientProcess
method.description: Returns the content of the DispatchControl : it can be used for a direct call, if the basic methods do not suffice

method.name: StartingModel
method.description: Returns the Model from which the transfer is to be done

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the List of Copied Results

method.name: Bind
method.description: Binds a (Transient) Result to a (Transient) Starting Entity

method.name: Search
method.description: Searches for the Result bound to a Starting Entity If Found, returns True and fills <res> Else, returns False and nullifies <res>
